'''TC-14 A invasion hum...''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[TC-14 (GPN)|TC-14]]
* '''Published:''' 9 March 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Invasion|Theed-D-invasion.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Invasion
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR3 Invasion TC-14 DS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Using the Theed Palace Objective, a deck easy to play and capable of turning in 2 or 3 turns...

The published list has 61 cards.

== Strategy ==

If you see the cards you will notice that almost all cards can deploy from Reserve Deck except Maul. The batle droids from the Hallway and Expand the Empire. The Neimodians with blockade Flagship and Phantom Menace. the Effects with we must accelerate our plans.

The only problem is I dont have Sense and Alter but with the Defensives Shields like there is no try do the trick.

Give your opinion. If you dont understand why some cards are in deck say so and I will answer.

I dont use V cards but fell free to tell if some card is good for this deck
